clause: Alignment / distribution / guides / snapping / isolation mode [STU-VEC-029]

scope.summary: Implement the vector alignment + measurement surfaces: align/distribute to selection/key-object/artboard with numeric spacing, ruler guides + object-to-guide conversion + release-guide-back-to-object, live distance guides showing spacing to neighbors/artboard, snap-to-perpendicular + snap-to-tangent while drawing, pixel-snapping for raster-targeted output, isolation mode (isolate a group/subpath/symbol for editing while dimming+locking the rest with a breadcrumb to exit levels), and distribute/orient objects along an arbitrary path spine.
acceptance_criteria: align/distribute + guides + snap + pixel-snap + isolation + distribute-along-path; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: align/distribute + isolation-mode reachable via author_id
test: align to key-object/artboard with numeric spacing; snap-perpendicular/tangent; isolation dims+locks rest with breadcrumb; distribute along path spine

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Align, guides, snapping & isolation mode

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
